Gewinnen or Verdienen? German B1 Money and Success

Compare winning a prize with earning money or deserving something. Practise gewinnen and verdienen using the source of the reward.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the difference

Gewinnen means winning a contest or prize and can also mean gaining something. Verdienen means earning through work or deserving something: Geld verdienen, eine Pause verdienen. A payment for work and a competition prize are different situations, even though both may involve money.

Common mistake to avoid

Both verbs have uses beyond money. Avoid making the amount of money the rule; identify whether it was earned, deserved or won.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Compare the meaning and sentence pattern, rather than choosing by English translation alone.

Worked example 1Die Mannschaft gewinnt den regionalen Pokal.The team wins the regional cup.
Worked example 2Mit Übersetzungen verdient Jona seinen Lebensunterhalt.Jona earns his living through translation.
Worked example 3Sie hat bei der Verlosung ein Fahrrad gewonnen.She won a bicycle in the raffle.
Worked example 4Nach der langen Arbeit verdienen wir eine Pause.After the long work we deserve a break.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose gewinnen for the specified contest/prize and verdienen for earnings or deserving. Conjugate as requested. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Er ___ sein Geld als Gärtner. (earns)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: verdient

Verdienen describes earnings from work.

Question 2. Unser Team möchte das Finale ___. (win)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: gewinnen

A competition result takes gewinnen.

Question 3. Du hast dir eine Erholung ___. (deserved, Partizip II)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: verdient

The pattern sich etwas verdienen expresses deserving it.

Question 4. Sie hat einen Gutschein beim Quiz ___. (won, Partizip II)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: gewonnen

The participle of gewinnen is gewonnen.

Use it in your own sentence

Contrast earning money through work with winning a prize.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Sie verdient Geld im Café und gewinnt einen kleinen Preis.

Check your wording: A wage is earned; a competition prize is won.

What to practise next

Write a new context for each word. Explain which meaning or object pattern makes your choice natural; some contexts allow both.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
